experiment: actual pretrained exact-zero weight block audit
evidence_level: direct read-only checkpoint measurement in successful GitHub Actions CI
limitations: Model sizes differ and are small; results cannot be generalized to all trained models.
Only 2D checkpoint weight tensors were measured, not activation vectors or model output quality.
Zero block audits exclude partial edge blocks.
No pruning or modified weights were considered.
No hardware memory traffic, speed, energy, clock or actual GPU comparison was measured.
decision: Reject unpruned exact-zero weight block bypass as primary acceleration for these two measured models; continue alternate designs.
